auto_context.card: This is an archived Japanese-language co-op gameplay livestream uploaded on January 7, 2021, to the channel of Korone (Inugami Korone), a VTuber from Hololive Gamers. She is playing the co-op action-adventure game A Way Out alongside fellow Hololive VTuber Sakura Miko; the pair's combined nickname "みっころね" (Mikkorone) appears in the title and stream hashtag. The stream is a continuation of a previous session, and the tone is casual and energetic, typical of Hololive entertainment streams. Proper nouns to watch for include the game title "A Way Out," the speaker names Korone and Miko, and the group name Hololive.
